title: Below Basin / Subterrain Vessel — Spatial Contract
purpose: Define the round lower Potato platform as one coherent navigational vessel that can host subculture, Sektur, Farm, Swamp, Mud, Ash, Roots, intelligence, media, money, classifiers, law, harm and Forge processing without turning unlike concepts into synonyms.
master_image: A shallow circular pot, pool or trough beneath the World plane. Material enters around the rim, circulates across the surface, gathers into semi-bounded territories and extraction loops, mixes with institutional currents, settles into Mud/Ash, roots into provenance, and can be pulled through the central Drain/Root Junction into Forge processing and eventual return.
category_rule: Visual placement shows relation and process, not moral rank. Below is a standing view; Swamp is a regime/terrain condition; Sektur is social territory; Farm is a production process; Mud/Ash/Soil are material states; Roots are provenance organisms; Forge is transformation process; Drain/Spiral are routes; Axis is the exact center coordinate.

geometry.shape: circular shallow basin / flat pot / trough
geometry.orientation: viewed from slightly above as a round platform
geometry.radial_story: World-facing rim -> culture/subculture surface -> Sektur territories and Farm loops -> Swamp entanglement currents -> Mud/Ash sediment -> Root memory -> Drain/Forge processing -> Return
geometry.depth_story: What sinks is not automatically worse. Sinking means becoming residue, evidence, provenance or unresolved material. What rises is not automatically true. Material rises only through verification/repair or clearly labelled uncertainty.

zones.label: Rim / World Interfaces
zones.function: Where visible World events, claims, money, people and institutions enter or leave the Below view.
zones.boundary: Presence on the rim means interface relevance, not guilt or Swamp membership.

zones.label: Surface Water / Culture
zones.visual: broad shallow water across most of basin
zones.function: Shared meanings circulate and encounter one another here.

zones.label: Sektur Patches
zones.visual: semi-bounded islands/pools floating in the basin
zones.function: Semi-bounded territories where recurring roles, lore, status, allies, rivals and attention relations become self-reproducing.
zones.historical_anchor: Da Sektur remains a dated livestream/internet-bloodsports referent; the project generalization is broader.

zones.label: Farm Loops
zones.visual: looping wheels/tracks crossing one or more Sektur patches
zones.function: Converts events or people into repeatable attention yield.
zones.rule: A Farm can operate across a Sektur, outside it, or across multiple platforms; it is not a place.

zones.label: Currents
zones.function: Move material between social, commercial, political and institutional zones.

zones.label: Swamp
zones.visual: darkened stagnant/entangled region where currents overlap and slow
zones.function: Condition in which opacity, unresolved residue, extraction, role-lock, jurisdictional fragmentation and blocked correction become self-reinforcing.
zones.test: Does the system require unresolved conflict, opacity or recurrence in order to keep reproducing?

zones.label: Mud
zones.function: What accumulates and can either feed repeated Strife or be processed into evidence/Soil.

zones.label: Ash
zones.function: Post-rupture residue that can move toward Mud/Strife or Soil/Life.

zones.label: Roots / Provenance
zones.visual: root network visible beneath translucent basin floor
zones.function: Preserves where material came from and what supports it.
zones.rule: Roots are not Strife by default.

zones.label: Forge Ring
zones.visual: bright inner annulus around central drain
zones.function: Concentrates and transforms material before it can be promoted, repaired, rejected or returned.

zones.label: Drain / Root Junction / Axis
zones.visual: small central opening at exact center
zones.function: Routes material out of stagnant recurrence and into bounded processing; can also symbolize destructive drain/Strife when material loops downward without verification or repair.
zones.rule: The Axis is the center coordinate. Drain is a route. Forge is the process around/through it.

inhabitants_and_roles.meaning: subject made repeatedly harvestable by an attention ecology
cultivation/processing role: watches, archives, clips, interprets, provokes or packages
reaction/pursuit role: attack, defend, expose, monitor, follow, amplify
project metaphor for activity repeatedly sustained by accumulated conflict residue
applies a category under a methodology; may be private, academic or governmental
collects and tests evidence under institutional or research rules

inhabitants_and_roles.placement: where consequence actually occurs, not as scenery
inhabitants_and_roles.meaning: person affected by attention, harassment, exploitation, classification or institutional response

story_sequence: 2. Platforms and communities notice it at the Rim.
3. Culture gives it language, symbols and roles.
4. A Sektur may form when the relations become durable and semi-bounded.
5. Farm loops may turn the event/person into repeatable attention.
6. Media, money, status, classifiers, politics and law create currents through the basin.
7. If correction works, material can leave quickly; if not, residue accumulates as Mud/Ash.
8. When opacity, extraction and blocked accountability reinforce one another, the local condition becomes Swamp-like.
9. Roots preserve provenance beneath the visible conflict.
10. The central Forge separates source, claim, status, mechanism and consequence.
11. Outputs may be rejected, documented, adjudicated, repaired, turned into Soil/Living Root or safely returned to the World.
12. Unrepaired material can recirculate and seed another Tree of Strife.
